# PsxWorth

> PsxWorth is an AI-powered portfolio tracking platform built specifically for Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) investors.

## What is PsxWorth?

PsxWorth is a PSX portfolio tracker focused on performance, weightage, and returns. It lets you seamlessly import your portfolio from any source with AI transaction parsing — no other PSX tracker offers this — plus portfolio performance tracking, sector weightage, historical returns, dividend and corporate action tracking, and ETF holdings analysis.

## Core Features

### Portfolio performance, weightage & returns
Track portfolio performance over time, sector and stock weightage, and historical returns. Interactive charts and comprehensive analytics for data-driven decisions.

### AI transaction parsing
Allows users to seamlessly import their portfolio from any source very quickly. No other PSX tracker offers this.

### PSX Dividend, Bonus, Split, and Right Issue Tracker
Track all upcoming PSX corporate actions including dividends, bonus shares, stock splits, and right issues. View book closure dates and payment schedules to never miss an entitlement.

### ETF Holdings and Underlying Stock Weightage for PSX ETFs
See the underlying stock weightage of any PSX ETF in your portfolio. Understand your true exposure across all holdings including ETF components. No other PSX tracker offers this.

### Historical Portfolio Returns Tracking for PSX Investors
Track your PSX portfolio performance over time with interactive charts. View daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly returns from your first transaction.

### Comprehensive Portfolio Analytics
View sector allocation, stock weightage, realized vs unrealized gains, average cost per share, dividend yield, and total returns for data-driven investment decisions.
